Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
Sources: npm packages tesseract.js@7.0.0, tesseract.js-core@7.0.0
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
License: Apache-2.0 (included LICENSE files).

Japanese/English trained data: @tesseract.js-data/jpn@1.0.0 and
@tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int. Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

Only LSTM-only cores (scalar, SIMD, relaxed SIMD) are included.
The caller always uses OEM 1, legacyCore=false and legacyLang=false.
Each wasm.js embeds its WebAssembly binary. Do not switch to legacy OEM
without adding the corresponding core and language files.
Assets load only when screenshots are selected. No CDN is used at runtime.
